names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9744.html` link carries in its `title`, «Павел (Брянцев), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off; the surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays. The day's line prints «Павла» twice; this is the first of the two, name link 9744 against the other's 9748. `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст., which is the year for all fourteen people that line names. His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Антония , еп. Белгородского, и с ним Митрофана , Александра , Михаила , Ипполита , Николая , Василия , Николая , Максима , Александра , Павла , Павла , Георгия пресвитеров и мч. Михаила (1938).»

attestations.note: Tenth of the thirteen named «и с ним» after the bishop of Belgorod, and the first of the line's two Pauls, told apart from the second only by the name links, 9744 and 9748. **The line and the name link are all there is**: 9744 is a heading, the grade and **three** days — «26 января (Новомуч.) , 19 мая , 8 июня (Петерб.)» — with no narrative. The 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs and the 8 июня the synaxis of the saints of St Petersburg; both are companies' feasts and neither is a second day of his own (BRIEF.md §8). He is one of only two of the fourteen whose page carries that third day. azbyka.ru was not read.
